profile.headline: SWE @ Coinbase | B.S. CS + B.A. Econ Graduate | bianlee.me
profile.summary:
bianlee.me

I attained 2 degrees in B.S. Computer Science and B.A. Economics at the University of California, Davis, completing coursework in just 3 years (9 quarter terms). Throughout undergraduate years I completed 5 internships at an early-stage startup, a State government agency (year-long tenure), and various corporate settings including Wealth Management and Big Tech.

I have also independently developed engineering and problem-solving skills through building software businesses of my own, scaling to over $2k in total profit (and growing). I have passion for various industries ranging from tech, crypto, fintech, music/media, and demonstrated so through both technical & non-technical projects and campus involvement.

Please contact me via email at bianlee2004@gmail.com (or LinkedIn DM) for any general inquiries or moonshot ideas/opportunities. Currently based in sunny Orange County, California. Open to relocation anywhere in the United States.

projects.title: Yoga Form Detection/Correction Model with Real-Time Video Feed
projects.description: Used TensorFlow’s PoseNet model to build a live webcam feed that tracks body points in relative coordinates, comparing them against a ML model trained on images of correct yoga forms to give generative feedback through Gemini API.

projects.title: Mentor/Mentee Real-Time Communication App
projects.description: Developed and launched a full-stack social application designed to pair mentees with mentors (students with alumni), integrating authentication, real-time 1:1 messaging, profile creation/editing, searching, and filtering capabilities. Submission for ECS164 term project.
